answer.text:
Production finished 150 good units below the approved plan: 2154 against 2304. Line 03 missed by 138 units; Line 02 missed by 38 units; Line 01 exceeded plan by 26 units. The 726-unit loss from theoretical capacity is a different baseline from this 150-unit plan miss.

I would start with the feeder-jam evidence on Line 03. The speed residual remains unattributed.

Fictional process OP-030 feeds NW-A P2 components on FEED-03. This fragment links potential failures and controls. No approved numerical rating method or licensed scoring content is loaded.

{"characteristic":"Documented feeder setup conformity","detection":"DC-030-01 · retain feed-interruption record for review","prevention":"PC-030-01 · record setup acceptance against employer-approved reference","process_step":"OP-030","reaction":"Use the approved site escalation procedure; this demo contains no operating or safety instructions","record":"Fictional setup record SR-030 and event ledger"}

Fictional revision D replaces C for NW-A P2. It adds a setup conformance evidence field and connects the record to the current control plan. This document deliberately omits machine operation, adjustment, isolation and restart instructions.
For the demo record, capture setup reference ID, product revision, observation timestamp, reviewer and conformance disposition. Equipment actions require actual employer-approved procedures, qualified personnel and applicable safety controls. This text is not an instruction to operate equipment.

Historical fictional revision: record setup reference ID and reviewer. It does not include the product revision or conformance evidence field introduced in FIC-D. Retained for historical investigation only.

Fictional CASE-003: feeder-jam loss is 600 minutes over ten comparable baseline shifts, 2026-09-21 through 2026-10-02. The selected 2026-10-06 shift has 72 feeder-jam minutes. These periods must not be conflated.
Guide wear or setup variation is a hypothesis linked to FC-030-01, not an established cause. Competing hypotheses include component variation and event classification error. No measurement establishing a causal mechanism is included.
Compare ten eligible post-action shifts with the pinned baseline, retain performed-work evidence and evaluate final quality loss, energy and safety guardrails. Numerical improvement alone does not prove the hypothesis or justify risk re-rating. Financial validation is unavailable.
Fictional note claims the old two-field setup record is sufficient for all product revisions. It conflicts with SW-030 FIC-D and has no approval or effective scope.

NOTE-2401:s1: Feeder stopped with housings backed up at the guide during JOB-8301.
NOTE-2401:s2: Guide wear may be contributing; no dimensional inspection was completed.
NOTE-2401:s3: No motor fault was observed on the available alarm display.
NOTE-2401:s4: Production resumed after the approved recovery procedure; cause remains unconfirmed.

NOTE-2402:s1: Feeder jam recurred during JOB-8302 with NW-A revision P2.
NOTE-2402:s2: Visual check found no obvious guide damage.
NOTE-2402:s3: Setup variation is suspected, but setup measurements were not recorded.
NOTE-2402:s4: No component was replaced; return to service was recorded by the shift lead.
